overall: Atlanta is tracking a warm but notably dry late-June afternoon — dewpoints in the low 50s°F and calm winds with only 12% cloud cover are supportive of continued warming, though the pace is moderating. At 13:39 ET the running max has already reached 82.4°F and is still climbing at +1.8°F/hr, suggesting the peak is still ahead but likely not far off. max_temp_prediction: With the running max at 82.4°F and velocity at +1.8°F/hr, and the intraday model placing peak timing around 14.7h ET (~2:42 PM), approximately 1–1.3 hours of additional warming remain, implying a gain of roughly 1.8–2.3°F from the current reading. Confidence is moderately high: clear skies and low dewpoints support the range, but the earlier-than-model peak timing and possibility that NWP models' later peak timing (16–17h) is correct introduces some upside tail risk toward 85–86°F.
